title: How Mexico killed the powerful drug kingpin 'El Mencho' and what it means
summary: Mexico’s security forces on Sunday killed Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes, the nation's most powerful cartel leader, after he was wounded during an attempted arrest in Jalisco state and died while being transferred to Mexico City.
